messages:
maya: heads up — APAC depot scanned incoming RMA batch but manifest mismatch. depot scanned 3 A100-80GB units, manifest only lists 2 serials. one serial missing from manifest and vendor tag says QTR-334 on the way :eyes:
andre: ugh. which depot? can we hot-swap from eu pool? how urgent is the drain on apac-cluster-2?
maya: SFO->SGP routing via DHL stop. depot id APAC-HKG-07. apac-cluster-2 has 12 nodes degraded, we're hitting 85% capacity on preemptible fallback. user latency spike on realtime queue. need swap or handcarry ASAP.
li: i'll try to reconcile manifests first — maybe scanner OCR dropped a character. running serial-reconcile against the inbound manifest now.
li: ```
# quick run
python infra/tools/serial_reconcile.py --manifest /tmp/inbound_2111.csv --depot APAC-HKG-07 --ticket RMA-53421 --mode verify
```
warehouse-eu: we have 2 tested refurbished A100s in EU-WEST spare rack 3, tagged for next-day handcarry. customs ETA ~36-48h (paperwork submitted). can also cross-ship express but cost > $1.2k per card. :truck: :money_with_wings:
andre: cost ok if it avoids customer incidents. ops-oncall, can we drain the worst nodes and patch routing to use dedicated burst in us-west for next 24h?
ops-oncall: I can orchestrate drains. recommend: drain 6 problematic nodes (lowest utilization) and migrate pods to us-west-burst. will open a migration job and set autoscale min to avoid OOMs. tagging @li for the manifest update so we don't double-allocate serials.
rma-bot: Ticket RMA-53421 status updated — vendor QTrans reported "manifest attached, awaiting pickup". ETA updated to 2026-03-24T14:30Z. Tracking: https://rma.vendor/qtrans/53421
li: reconcile script found a near-match: scanned serial ended in '0' but manifest had 'O' (letter). fixed and re-uploaded manifest v3. changed inbound manifest checksum.
li: ```
# applied fix
aws s3 cp /tmp/inbound_2111_fixed.csv s3://inbound-manifests/APAC-HKG-07/2111112222-fixed.csv
./infra/deploy_manifest.sh --depot APAC-HKG-07 --file 2111112222-fixed.csv --ticket RMA-53421
```
maya: nice. warehouse-eu, if you can handcarry 1 unit express to SIN and cross-dock into HKG we can avoid the 36-48h customs delay. will the refurbished unit pass ECC / kvcache smoke tests?
warehouse-eu: yes, both units passed burn-in and ECC scans yesterday. will tag unit SN-EU-7781 for handcarry. need confirm PO number and oncall escort.
andre: i'll submit a priority PO now and loop in ops-oncall for escort. please add shipping note: "APAC urgent GPU handcarry - RMA-53421 - contact maya@redwood.com"
ops-oncall: i'll coordinate escort and local customs. set incident priority P2 for now and start drains. posting migration job id MIG-8802 in a sec.
maya: thanks everyone — plan: (1) li reconciles manifest (done), (2) ops-oncall drains 6 nodes + MIG-8802, (3) warehouse-eu handcarry SN-EU-7781 express to SIN cross-dock -> HKG, (4) andre submits PO. i'll monitor perf and update RMA ticket. :thumbsup:
andre: PO submitted (PO-99211). tagged finance for approval.
rma-bot: Vendor QTrans updated tracking: in transit to hub. ETA now 2026-03-23T22:10Z.
maya: closing loop — will follow up if any scan mismatch resurfaces. thanks all. :pray:
